title: Set up Claude Code in the cloud, live in seconds
excerpt: Set up Claude Code in the cloud in one click. zipbox boots a disposable sandbox where Anthropic’s agent launches itself at first boot. Free credit to start, no card.
content_html:
Claude CodeAnthropic

Claude Code with nothing held back.

Bypass permissions on, full root, a machine of its own. This is Claude Code the way it ships, minus the part where it can touch your laptop. The session on this page is real: write the server, run it, curl it, done.

time to a live terminalseconds

your URLclaude.zbox.sh

price$0.0342/hr · $25/mo

01

Sign in

Email if you want it simple, a crypto key if you want anonymity. No passwords, and every session is cryptographically signed.

02

Boot Claude Code

A fresh isolated sandbox boots and Claude Code installs and launches itself at first boot. On pay-per-use a metered key is injected; or paste your own key at boot.

03

It’s live in your browser

A full-root terminal opens in the browser and the box answers at its own zbox.sh subdomain. Pause parks it for free, delete wipes it for good, SSH is optional.

Questions, answered straight

Do I need an Anthropic API key to run Claude Code?
No. On pay-per-use, a metered key is injected when the sandbox boots and tokens are billed to your prepaid balance at cost plus 3%, and Claude Code works immediately. Prefer your own billing? Paste your Anthropic key at boot and pay them direct.

What does running Claude Code in the cloud cost?
$0.0342 per hour while the sandbox runs, about $25 a month left on 24/7, and $0 while it’s paused. You start with free credit, no card. Claude Code’s default machine is 2 vCPU · 4 GB RAM · 80 GB disk, and other sizes start at $10/mo.

What happens when I pause or delete a Claude Code sandbox?
Two buttons, honestly: Pause shuts the machine down and parks its disk for free. Restore it later and pick up where the agent left off. Delete wipes the whole VM: disk, memory, network, permanently. You only ever pay while it runs.

Is it safe to let Claude Code run unattended with full permissions?
In a sandbox, yes. That’s the point. The box is a hardware-isolated machine with its own kernel and none of your files, keys, or cookies. Close the tab and it keeps working; the blast radius is one disposable machine.

Can I SSH into the sandbox?
Optionally. The browser terminal is the default and needs no setup. Add an SSH public key when you boot and you can also connect from your own terminal: same machine, same session.

every agent zipbox boots

Claude Code, on a machine you can throw away.

One click boots Anthropic’s agentic coding tool on a disposable cloud machine, and you pay only while it runs.

02

引导克劳德代码

全新的隔离沙箱启动，Claude Code 会在首次启动时安装并启动。 按使用量付费时，会注入计量密钥；或在启动时粘贴您自己的密钥。

有问题，直接回答

我是否需要 Anthropic API 密钥来运行 Claude Code？不需要。在按使用付费时，当沙箱引导和令牌按成本加 3% 计入您的预付余额时，会注入计量密钥，并且 Claude Code 会立即运行。 更喜欢自己计费？ 在启动时粘贴您的 Anthropic 密钥并直接向他们付款。

在云中运行 Claude Code 的成本是多少？沙盒运行时每小时 0.0342 美元，24/7 每月约 25 美元，暂停时为 0 美元。 您从免费信用卡开始，无需信用卡。 Claude Code 的默认机器是 2 个 vCPU · 4 GB RAM · 80 GB 磁盘，其他大小的起价为 10 美元/月。

当我暂停或删除克劳德代码沙箱时会发生什么？老实说，有两个按钮：暂停会关闭机器并免费停放其磁盘。 稍后恢复并从代理中断的地方继续。 删除会永久擦除整个虚拟机：磁盘、内存、网络。 您只需在其运行时付费。

让 Claude Code 在无人值守的情况下以完全权限运行是否安全？在沙箱中，是的。 这就是重点。 该盒子是一台硬件隔离的机器，有自己的内核，没有您的文件、密钥或 cookie。 关闭选项卡，它继续工作；爆炸半径是一台一次性机器。

我可以通过 SSH 进入沙箱吗？可选。 浏览器终端是默认的，无需设置。 启动时添加 SSH 公钥，您也可以从自己的终端进行连接：同一台机器，同一会话。
